name: Key Nutrients
description: Key Nutrients makes clean, transparent electrolyte and hydration supplements — zero-sugar, zero-calorie electrolyte powders with disclosed dosing, plus collagen, keto and sleep products — and states it has shipped 250,000+ orders with 25,000+ five-star reviews.

evidence.summary: Key Nutrients' own Affiliate FAQ states the default commission is 15% for every conversion, rising by monthly sales volume to 20% at $500-$1,000 and 25% at $1,000+, with a 45-day cookie, PayPal payouts, and sign-up open to anyone including social-media-only promoters.

The same FAQ answers the question 'Is there any cap on the number of referrals I can generate?' with 'No! Your earning potential is unlimited' — an explicit unlimited-earnings statement about earning potential on the brand's own page, which is why commission_cap is recorded as uncapped; the companion program page repeats 'Unlimited Referrals — you will get paid on every sale'. No absolute creator-count data is published, so creator_saturation is unknown.

The brand's Become an Affiliate page routes sign-up through Rakuten LinkShare (signup.linkshare.com), pays by check or direct deposit on the 20th of each month, and summarises the offer as 15-25% on each conversion.

reasons.niche_fit: Electrolyte hydration, collagen and keto supplements are core topics for fitness, wellness and everyday-athlete creators.
reasons.ugc_evidence: The brand runs a formal affiliate program explicitly welcoming social-media promoters, with creatives and custom URLs.
reasons.compensation: 15% default commission rising to 25% on monthly volume, with earning potential stated as unlimited on the brand's own FAQ, so the cap is verified uncapped.
reasons.contact_access: Application runs through the brand's own affiliate pages and Rakuten; no public partnerships email was usable from the fetched pages.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Program is open now, free to join, with a 45-day cookie and monthly payouts.
reasons.credibility: The brand states 250,000+ orders shipped, 25,000+ five-star reviews and a #1 best-seller position on Amazon for its electrolytes.

name: Riva
description: Riva makes sugar-free, plant-based, Halal-certified gummy supplements — creatine, pre-workout, NAD+ and sleep formulas in full disclosed doses — shipping from its New Jersey facility with free US shipping over $40.

evidence.summary: Riva's own affiliate page pays 20% commission on a referred customer's first order and 10% on every reorder for the life of the customer, tracked by discount code rather than cookies, with monthly PayPal payouts, a 15% audience discount, and applications reviewed by a human within a couple of days.

The page's 'no cap' wording ('There's no cap and no limit on how many people you refer' and 'No cap on how many people you refer') is tied to the NUMBER of people referred, not to total earnings, so under the strict standard commission_cap is recorded as unknown rather than uncapped; no absolute creator-count data is published, so creator_saturation is unknown.

reasons.niche_fit: Creatine, pre-workout and sleep gummies are staple products for fitness, strength and daily-energy creators.
reasons.ugc_evidence: The brand runs its own affiliate program built for creators, coaches and trainers, with brand assets and early formula access.
reasons.compensation: 20% on first orders and 10% on every reorder for the life of the customer; the published no-cap wording covers referral count only, so the earnings cap is unknown.
reasons.contact_access: Application runs through the brand's own affiliate site; no public partnerships email was published on the fetched pages.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Program is open now, free to join, with human review in a couple of days.
reasons.credibility: Small, newer brand, but with third-party-tested, fully disclosed labels, Halal certification and a US fulfilment facility.
